graph_domains.name: Supply Chain Planning and Performance (multi-business)
expected_sources: Operations: sites, work orders, dosing plans
graph_domains.note: Order lines, stock, reservations, contracts, bids and scorecards are connected and profiled; policies, notices and contracts are in OneDrive.
graph_domains.unmet_note: No purchasing or stock source connected.

graph_domains.name: Procurement, Sourcing and Contract Compliance
graph_domains.note: Contracts, price lists, orders, invoices and bids resolve. The savings register is a tracker in OneDrive, not a table.

graph_domains.name: Inventory and Critical Spares
graph_domains.note: Stock, movements, reservations and outages resolve. 3.1% of critical positions have no reorder point, and Energy's dosing plans are the November 2025 vintage.

graph_domains.name: Logistics and Shipment Tracking
graph_domains.note: Carrier tracking is not connected, so where a shipment is and when it arrives cannot be read. Questions about arrivals are declined; promised dates on order lines are answered instead.

graph_personas.name: Chief Procurement Officer
graph_personas.focus: Owns group procurement. Asks what the group spends and with whom, how much is under contract, where the savings stand, and what goes to the Procurement Committee.

graph_personas.name: Chief Financial Officer (Procurement Committee chair)
graph_personas.focus: Chairs the Procurement Committee. Asks what an award costs and saves, what risk it carries, and how spend compares with the plan.

graph_personas.name: Head of Supply Chain Planning and Inventory
graph_personas.focus: Owns stock and supply continuity. Asks which critical items are short, what can be moved between sites, and which suppliers are slipping.

graph_personas.name: Category Manager, Chemicals and Process Materials
graph_personas.focus: Runs the chemicals category and its sourcing events. Asks what the bids save on landed cost, who is qualified, and what a force majeure exposes.

graph_personas.name: Category Manager, Maintenance, Repair and Operations
graph_personas.focus: Runs maintenance categories. Asks where spend leaks off contract, which sites pay different prices for one item, and how many suppliers serve a category.

graph_personas.name: Buyer
graph_personas.focus: Places and chases orders. Asks which lines are late and with whom, and which orders need expediting.

graph_personas.name: Plant Manager, Water
graph_personas.focus: Runs a water treatment works. Asks how many days of each chemical the plant holds and when the next delivery lands.

graph_personas.name: Outage Manager, Hazardous Waste
graph_personas.focus: Plans incinerator outages. Asks whether every reserved part will be there on time and what a missing part costs per day.

graph_personas.name: Operations Director, Energy
graph_personas.focus: Runs the energy plants. Asks what the plants use and spend, and whether the plans the group buys against are current.

graph_personas.name: Storeroom and Inventory Lead
graph_personas.focus: Runs a storeroom. Asks what is held, what has not moved, which items have no reorder point, and what can be released to another site.

graph_personas.name: Accounts Payable Lead
graph_personas.focus: Pays suppliers. Asks which invoices are above contract price, which match exceptions are open, and which vendor records are duplicates.

graph_personas.name: Finance Business Partner, Procurement
graph_personas.focus: Validates savings and tracks spend against plan. Asks what is secured against the target and how stock ties up cash.

graph_personas.name: Process Safety Manager
graph_personas.focus: Signs off bulk chemical storage and moves. Asks how much each plant holds against its tank limits and which moves need sign-off.

graph_personas.name: Business President
graph_personas.focus: Runs one of the three businesses. Asks what the business spends, on what, and how it compares with the plan and the other businesses.

graph_personas.name: Supplier Quality and Performance Manager
graph_personas.focus: Measures suppliers. Asks who is below target, which corrective actions are open, and who is qualified for what.

graph_personas.name: Internal Audit
graph_personas.focus: Tests procurement controls. Asks how many orders were raised after the invoice and how much was bought under exceptions.

graph_personas.name: Treasury and Working Capital
graph_personas.focus: Manages working capital. Asks what terms suppliers give, how much cash sits in stock, and which contracts move with an index.

graph_hero_questions.text: What did we spend with third parties this year, by business and category, against the plan?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across pur.po_line + fin.spend_plan + ops.site at high confidence (0.94).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT p.business_code, p.category_code, SUM(p.ordered_usd) AS spend_usd, SUM(sp.plan_usd) AS plan_usd
FROM pur.po_line p
LEFT JOIN fin.spend_plan sp ON sp.business_code = p.business_code AND sp.category_code = p.category_code AND sp.period = FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', p.ordered_on)
WHERE p.ordered_on BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY p.business_code, p.category_code

graph_hero_questions.text: How much of our spend is under a group contract, and where does it go off contract when a contract covers the item?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across pur.po_line + src.contract at high confidence (0.92); a line is leakage only when contract_price_usd shows a contract covers its material.
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT p.category_code, p.vendor_id, SUM(p.ordered_usd) AS off_contract_usd,
       SUM((p.unit_price_usd - p.contract_price_usd) * p.quantity) AS premium_usd
FROM pur.po_line p
WHERE p.contract_no IS NULL AND p.contract_price_usd IS NOT NULL AND p.ordered_on BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY p.category_code, p.vendor_id
ORDER BY off_contract_usd DESC

graph_hero_questions.text: Which invoices were paid above the contract price in the third quarter, and by how much?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across ap.invoice_line + pur.po_line + src.contract_item at high confidence (0.91).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT i.vendor_id, COUNT(*) AS lines, SUM(i.price_variance_usd) AS variance_usd,
       SUM(CASE WHEN i.match_status = 'Paid at invoice price' THEN i.price_variance_usd ELSE 0 END) AS paid_usd
FROM ap.invoice_line i
WHERE i.price_variance_usd > 0 AND i.invoice_date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY i.vendor_id
ORDER BY variance_usd DESC

graph_hero_questions.text: Where are we against the FY26 savings target?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: The target resolves from fin.spend_plan; the secured figure is read from the savings tracker in OneDrive at medium confidence (0.84).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT SUM(plan_usd) * 0.03 AS target_usd
FROM fin.spend_plan
WHERE addressable AND period BETWEEN '2026-01' AND '2026-12'
-- secured savings are read from Savings_tracker_2026-10.xlsx (no table holds the register)

graph_hero_questions.text: Which suppliers take the most off-contract spend where a contract covers the item?
graph_hero_questions.persona: Category Manager, Maintenance, Repair and Operations
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across pur.po_line + pur.vendor at high confidence (0.9).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT p.category_code, p.vendor_id, SUM(p.ordered_usd) AS off_contract_usd,
       SUM((p.unit_price_usd - p.contract_price_usd) * p.quantity) AS premium_usd
FROM pur.po_line p
WHERE p.contract_no IS NULL AND p.contract_price_usd IS NOT NULL AND p.ordered_on BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY p.category_code, p.vendor_id
ORDER BY off_contract_usd DESC

graph_hero_questions.text: How is spend spread across suppliers in each category, and where is it fragmented?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across pur.po_line + pur.vendor at high confidence (0.9).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT category_code, COUNT(DISTINCT vendor_id) AS suppliers, MAX(v_spend) / SUM(v_spend) AS top_share
FROM (SELECT category_code, vendor_id, SUM(ordered_usd) AS v_spend FROM pur.po_line WHERE ordered_on >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1, 2)
GROUP BY category_code

graph_hero_questions.text: Which critical items are below safety stock today?
graph_hero_questions.persona: Head of Supply Chain Planning and Inventory
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across mm.plant_stock + mm.material at high confidence (0.93).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT s.site_code, s.material_code, m.description, s.unrestricted_qty, s.safety_stock_qty
FROM mm.plant_stock s
JOIN mm.material m ON m.material_code = s.material_code
WHERE m.criticality = 'A' AND s.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM mm.plant_stock)
  AND s.unrestricted_qty < s.safety_stock_qty

graph_hero_questions.text: How many days of ferric chloride does each plant hold, against its minimum?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across mm.plant_stock + ops.site at high confidence (0.93); the minimum is read from the Inventory and Critical Spares Standard.
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT s.site_code, s.material_code, s.unrestricted_qty / NULLIF(s.avg_daily_use, 0) AS days_of_cover
FROM mm.plant_stock s
JOIN mm.material m ON m.material_code = s.material_code
WHERE m.category_code = 'CHEM' AND s.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM mm.plant_stock)
ORDER BY days_of_cover

graph_hero_questions.text: What is our inventory value by business, and how much has not moved in twelve months?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across mm.plant_stock + ops.site at medium confidence (0.82): the demo extract carries critical and chemical positions only.
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT s.site_code, s.material_code, s.stock_value_usd, s.last_movement_date
FROM mm.plant_stock s
WHERE s.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM mm.plant_stock) AND s.last_movement_date < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 365 DAY)

graph_hero_questions.text: Which critical items are held above safety stock at one site while another site is below?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across mm.plant_stock + ops.site at high confidence (0.88).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT need.site_code AS short_site, have.site_code AS holding_site, need.material_code, have.unrestricted_qty - have.safety_stock_qty AS releasable_qty
FROM mm.plant_stock need
JOIN mm.plant_stock have ON have.material_code = need.material_code AND have.site_code <> need.site_code AND have.snapshot_date = need.snapshot_date
WHERE need.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM mm.plant_stock)
  AND need.unrestricted_qty < need.safety_stock_qty AND have.unrestricted_qty > have.safety_stock_qty

graph_hero_questions.text: Will everything reserved for the Ravensworth Kiln 2 outage be there on time?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across mm.reservation + ops.work_order + mm.plant_stock + pur.po_line at high confidence (0.9).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT r.material_code, r.required_qty, r.requirement_date, s.unrestricted_qty, MIN(p.promised_date) AS next_receipt
FROM mm.reservation r
JOIN ops.work_order w ON w.work_order = r.work_order
JOIN mm.plant_stock s ON s.site_code = r.site_code AND s.material_code = r.material_code AND s.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM mm.plant_stock)
LEFT JOIN pur.po_line p ON p.site_code = r.site_code AND p.material_code = r.material_code AND p.line_status LIKE 'Open%'
WHERE w.outage_id = 'OUT-RAV-K2-2026'
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4

graph_hero_questions.text: What are inventory turns by business?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across mm.stock_movement + mm.plant_stock at medium confidence (0.78): movements are loaded for the critical and chemical positions only.
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT st.business_code, SUM(CASE WHEN m.movement_type IN ('201', '261') THEN -m.amount_usd ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(AVG(s.stock_value_usd), 0) AS turns
FROM mm.stock_movement m
JOIN ops.site st ON st.site_code = m.site_code
JOIN mm.plant_stock s ON s.site_code = m.site_code AND s.material_code = m.material_code
WHERE m.posting_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 365 DAY)
GROUP BY st.business_code

graph_hero_questions.text: Which suppliers had the worst on time in full in the third quarter?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across pur.po_line + src.supplier_scorecard at high confidence (0.93).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT p.vendor_id, COUNT(*) AS lines,
       AVG(CASE WHEN p.received_on <= p.promised_date AND p.delivered_complete THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS otif
FROM pur.po_line p
WHERE p.received_on IS NOT NULL AND p.promised_date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY p.vendor_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY otif

graph_hero_questions.text: How have lead times on critical spares moved this year against the contract lead times?
graph_hero_questions.persona: Head of Supply Chain Planning and Inventory
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across pur.po_line + src.contract_item at high confidence (0.88).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT p.vendor_id, AVG(DATE_DIFF(p.received_on, p.ordered_on, DAY)) AS actual_days, AVG(ci.lead_time_days) AS contract_days
FROM pur.po_line p
JOIN src.contract_item ci ON ci.contract_no = p.contract_no AND ci.material_code = p.material_code
WHERE p.received_on IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.vendor_id

graph_hero_questions.text: Which open order lines are past their promised date, and with whom?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across pur.po_line + pur.vendor at high confidence (0.92).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT p.po_number, p.vendor_id, p.site_code, p.material_code, p.promised_date, DATE_DIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), p.promised_date, DAY) AS days_late, p.ordered_usd
FROM pur.po_line p
WHERE p.line_status = 'Open late'
ORDER BY days_late DESC

graph_hero_questions.text: Which critical items have a single qualified source?
graph_hero_questions.persona: Head of Supply Chain Planning and Inventory
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across mm.material + mm.plant_stock at high confidence (0.9).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT m.material_code, m.description, m.preferred_vendor_id, SUM(s.unrestricted_qty) AS group_stock
FROM mm.material m
LEFT JOIN mm.plant_stock s ON s.material_code = m.material_code AND s.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM mm.plant_stock)
WHERE m.criticality = 'A' AND m.single_source
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3

graph_hero_questions.text: How much do we spend on contracts that expire in the next six months?
graph_hero_questions.persona: Category Manager, Maintenance, Repair and Operations
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across src.contract + pur.po_line at high confidence (0.9).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT c.contract_no, c.title, c.end_date, SUM(p.ordered_usd) AS spend_usd
FROM src.contract c
JOIN pur.po_line p ON p.contract_no = c.contract_no AND p.ordered_on >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 12 MONTH)
WHERE c.end_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH)
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3

graph_hero_questions.text: What would the bids in SE-2026-031 save against today's prices, on landed cost?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across src.bid + src.contract_item + ops.dosing_plan at high confidence (0.88); Energy volumes are the November 2025 plan.
graph_hero_questions.sql:
WITH vol AS (SELECT material_code, SUM(plan_tons) AS tons FROM ops.dosing_plan WHERE plan_year = 2027 GROUP BY material_code)
SELECT b.lot_id, v.tons, ci.unit_price_usd AS current_price, b.unit_price_usd + b.freight_usd_per_unit AS awarded_landed
FROM src.bid b
JOIN vol v ON v.material_code = b.material_code
JOIN src.contract_item ci ON ci.material_code = b.material_code AND ci.valid_to = '2026-12-31'
WHERE b.event_id = 'SE-2026-031' AND b.qualified

graph_hero_questions.text: What does the Corrigan force majeure expose, and what have the spot buys cost so far?
graph_hero_questions.persona: Category Manager, Chemicals and Process Materials
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across pur.po_line + mm.plant_stock + ops.dosing_plan at high confidence (0.89); the allocation is read from the notice in OneDrive.
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT d.site_code, SUM(d.plan_tons) * 0.4 AS unshipped_tons_a_year
FROM ops.dosing_plan d
WHERE d.material_code = 'CHM-FECL-40' AND d.plan_year = 2027
GROUP BY d.site_code

graph_hero_questions.text: How much of each treatment chemical does each business use now, and what does the 2027 plan say?
graph_hero_questions.persona: Category Manager, Chemicals and Process Materials
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across ops.dosing_plan + ops.site at medium confidence (0.83): Energy plans are the November 2025 vintage.
graph_hero_questions.sql:

FROM ops.dosing_plan d

graph_hero_questions.text: Which bidders on SE-2026-031 are not qualified for the lots they bid?
graph_hero_questions.persona: Category Manager, Chemicals and Process Materials
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across src.bid + the qualification register in OneDrive at high confidence (0.9).
graph_hero_questions.sql:

FROM src.bid b

graph_hero_questions.text: Which three-way match exceptions are open, and why?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across ap.invoice_line + ap.match_exception at high confidence (0.9).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT e.exception_type, COUNT(*) AS open_exceptions, SUM(e.amount_usd) AS amount_usd
FROM ap.match_exception e
WHERE e.status = 'Open'
GROUP BY e.exception_type

graph_hero_questions.text: How many orders were raised after the invoice in the third quarter?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across ap.invoice_line + pur.po_line at high confidence (0.9).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS lines, SUM(invoiced_usd) AS amount_usd
FROM ap.invoice_line
WHERE after_the_fact_po AND invoice_date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'

graph_hero_questions.text: What payment terms do we get, weighted by spend, against the 45-day policy?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across pur.po_line + pur.vendor at high confidence (0.9).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT SUM(p.ordered_usd * v.payment_terms_days) / SUM(p.ordered_usd) AS weighted_terms_days
FROM pur.po_line p
JOIN pur.vendor v ON v.vendor_id = p.vendor_id
WHERE p.ordered_on >= '2026-01-01'

graph_hero_questions.text: Which suppliers have an open corrective action request?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across src.supplier_scorecard + the corrective action requests in OneDrive at high confidence (0.9).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT vendor_id, quarter, otif_pct
FROM src.supplier_scorecard
WHERE car_open AND quarter = '2026-Q3'

graph_hero_questions.text: How much of our spend sits on index-linked contracts?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across src.contract + pur.po_line at high confidence (0.89).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT c.index_clause, SUM(p.ordered_usd) AS spend_usd
FROM pur.po_line p
JOIN src.contract c ON c.contract_no = p.contract_no
WHERE c.index_clause IS NOT NULL AND p.ordered_on >= '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY c.index_clause

graph_hero_questions.text: How much did we buy under exception codes this year, and what did it cost above contract?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across pur.po_line at high confidence (0.92).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT exception_code, FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', ordered_on) AS month, SUM(ordered_usd) AS amount_usd
FROM pur.po_line
WHERE exception_code IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2

graph_hero_questions.text: Which sites pay different prices for the same chemical?
graph_hero_questions.persona: Category Manager, Chemicals and Process Materials
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across pur.po_line + ops.site at high confidence (0.9).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT p.material_code, MIN(p.unit_price_usd) AS low, MAX(p.unit_price_usd) AS high, COUNT(DISTINCT p.site_code) AS sites
FROM pur.po_line p
WHERE p.material_code IS NOT NULL AND p.ordered_on >= '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY p.material_code
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.site_code) > 1

graph_hero_questions.text: Which critical items have no reorder point set?

graph_hero_questions.text: What has the Ravensworth Kiln 2 outage reserved, and what is it worth?

graph_hero_questions.text: What are the scope 3 emissions of our chemical suppliers?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Declined: supplier emissions are not in any connected source.

graph_hero_questions.text: What does Helena need for the 12 November committee, and what is ready?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across the mailbox (thread A1) and the sourcing folder at medium confidence (0.84).

graph_hero_questions.text: Which vendor records look like duplicates?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across pur.vendor at high confidence (0.88): same tax number, two vendor ids.
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT v.tax_id, ARRAY_AGG(v.vendor_id) AS vendor_ids, ARRAY_AGG(v.vendor_name) AS names
FROM pur.vendor v
WHERE v.vendor_status = 'Active'
GROUP BY v.tax_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

graph_hero_questions.text: Which pump will fail next at Marston Reach?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Declined: equipment condition and failure history are not connected, and the graph does not predict failures.

graph_use_cases.name: Supply Chain Analyst · Bramwell Water, Bramwell Hazardous Waste, Bramwell Energy, Group Procurement and Shared Services

spend: Report third-party spend against plan by business and category
Measure spend under contract and the leakage where a contract covers the item
Find invoices above the contract price
Track payment terms against the 45-day policy
sourcing: Build the volume baseline from dosing plans and run rates
Compare bids on landed cost: price, freight and index terms
Draft the award paper and schedule for the Procurement Committee
inventory: Watch critical positions against safety stock after every nightly load
Look across the group before an emergency buy
chem: Track days of cover per plant and chemical against the minimums
Size the exposure when a supplier declares force majeure
Arrange spot volume under exception FMX
outage: Check reservations against stock and promised dates
Arrange transfers and expedites for gaps
Report readiness to the outage manager
supplier: Publish quarterly scorecards: on time in full, lead time, price
savings: Record savings when they are in an order or a signed contract
Reconcile the tracker with Finance each month
report: Monthly procurement report after the close
Monthly shortage review with the buyers

graph_use_cases.business_need: Supply Chain Analyst for Bramwell Water, Bramwell Hazardous Waste, Bramwell Energy and Group Procurement and Shared Services (environmental services). Keeps critical spares and treatment chemicals available across the three businesses, checks spend is on contract at the contract price, and supports sourcing events with landed-cost analysis. Responsible for spend and contract compliance; sourcing and award support; inventory and critical spares; treatment chemical continuity; outage material readiness; supplier performance; savings program; reporting. Reports to nishant.srivastav@vriodigital.com.

metrics.name: Spend against plan
metrics.description: Ordered spend / plan for the same months, by business and category · Unit: $ and % · Cadence: Monthly · Flags: Over 105% or under 90%

metrics.name: Spend under contract
metrics.description: Spend on a group contract / total spend · Unit: % · Cadence: Monthly · Flags: Below 80%

hero_questions.text: What did we spend with third parties this year, by business and category, against the plan?
hero_questions.sql:
SELECT business_code, category_code, plan_usd, addressable
FROM `fin`.`spend_plan`
LIMIT 1000

hero_questions.text: How much of our spend is under a group contract, and where does it go off contract when a contract covers the item?
hero_questions.sql:
SELECT contract_no, contract_price_usd, exception_code, ordered_usd
FROM `pur`.`po_line`
LIMIT 1000

graph_use_case_templates.name: Supply Chain Analyst
graph_use_case_templates.description: One graph over order lines, stock, reservations, contracts, bids and scorecards across every business, so a supply question resolves once and states which snapshot, which contract price and which plan it read.

graph_metrics.name: Third-party spend
graph_metrics.definition: Ordered value of purchase order lines by order date, by business and category, against the FY26 spend plan for the same months.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT p.business_code, p.category_code, SUM(p.ordered_usd) AS spend_usd, SUM(sp.plan_usd) AS plan_usd
FROM pur.po_line p
LEFT JOIN fin.spend_plan sp ON sp.business_code = p.business_code AND sp.category_code = p.category_code AND sp.period = FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', p.ordered_on)
WHERE p.ordered_on BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY p.business_code, p.category_code

graph_metrics.name: Spend under contract
graph_metrics.definition: Ordered value placed on a group contract, as a share of all ordered value in the period.
personas: Category Manager, Maintenance, Repair and Operations
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN contract_no IS NOT NULL THEN ordered_usd ELSE 0 END) / SUM(ordered_usd) AS under_contract_share
FROM pur.po_line
WHERE ordered_on BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-09-30'

graph_metrics.name: Off-contract spend where a contract covers the item
graph_metrics.definition: Ordered value placed off contract on lines whose material is covered by a group contract (contract_price_usd is not null). Spend in categories with no contract is not leakage.
personas: Category Manager, Maintenance, Repair and Operations
Category Manager, Chemicals and Process Materials
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT p.category_code, p.vendor_id, SUM(p.ordered_usd) AS off_contract_usd,
       SUM((p.unit_price_usd - p.contract_price_usd) * p.quantity) AS premium_usd
FROM pur.po_line p
WHERE p.contract_no IS NULL AND p.contract_price_usd IS NOT NULL AND p.ordered_on BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY p.category_code, p.vendor_id
ORDER BY off_contract_usd DESC

graph_metrics.name: Invoice price variance
graph_metrics.definition: Invoice lines priced above the contract price: (invoiced price minus contract price) times quantity, with the match status.
personas: Category Manager, Maintenance, Repair and Operations
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT i.vendor_id, COUNT(*) AS lines, SUM(i.price_variance_usd) AS variance_usd,
       SUM(CASE WHEN i.match_status = 'Paid at invoice price' THEN i.price_variance_usd ELSE 0 END) AS paid_usd
FROM ap.invoice_line i
WHERE i.price_variance_usd > 0 AND i.invoice_date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY i.vendor_id
ORDER BY variance_usd DESC

graph_metrics.name: Savings against target
graph_metrics.definition: Savings secured (in a signed contract or an order, against the prior contract price on planned volumes) against 3.0% of addressable spend. Read from the savings tracker; avoided premiums are not counted.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT SUM(plan_usd) * 0.03 AS target_usd
FROM fin.spend_plan
WHERE addressable AND period BETWEEN '2026-01' AND '2026-12'
-- secured savings are read from Savings_tracker_2026-10.xlsx (no table holds the register)

graph_metrics.name: Supplier on time in full
graph_metrics.definition: Order lines received complete on or before the promised date, as a share of lines received, by supplier and quarter.
personas: Head of Supply Chain Planning and Inventory
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT p.vendor_id, COUNT(*) AS lines,
       AVG(CASE WHEN p.received_on <= p.promised_date AND p.delivered_complete THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS otif
FROM pur.po_line p
WHERE p.received_on IS NOT NULL AND p.promised_date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY p.vendor_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY otif

graph_metrics.name: Supplier lead time against contract
graph_metrics.definition: Average days from order to receipt, against the contract lead time, by supplier and quarter.
personas: Head of Supply Chain Planning and Inventory
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT p.vendor_id, AVG(DATE_DIFF(p.received_on, p.ordered_on, DAY)) AS actual_days, AVG(ci.lead_time_days) AS contract_days
FROM pur.po_line p
JOIN src.contract_item ci ON ci.contract_no = p.contract_no AND ci.material_code = p.material_code
WHERE p.received_on IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.vendor_id

graph_metrics.name: Late open order lines
graph_metrics.definition: Open order lines whose promised date has passed, with days late and value.
personas: Head of Supply Chain Planning and Inventory
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT p.po_number, p.vendor_id, p.site_code, p.material_code, p.promised_date, DATE_DIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), p.promised_date, DAY) AS days_late, p.ordered_usd
FROM pur.po_line p
WHERE p.line_status = 'Open late'
ORDER BY days_late DESC

graph_metrics.name: Critical items below safety stock
graph_metrics.definition: Class A positions (site and material) whose unrestricted stock is below safety stock at the latest snapshot.
personas: Head of Supply Chain Planning and Inventory
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT s.site_code, s.material_code, m.description, s.unrestricted_qty, s.safety_stock_qty
FROM mm.plant_stock s
JOIN mm.material m ON m.material_code = s.material_code
WHERE m.criticality = 'A' AND s.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM mm.plant_stock)
  AND s.unrestricted_qty < s.safety_stock_qty

graph_metrics.name: Days of chemical cover
graph_metrics.definition: Unrestricted stock divided by average daily use, per plant and treatment chemical, against the minimum (14 days water, 10 hazardous waste, 7 energy).
personas: Category Manager, Chemicals and Process Materials
Head of Supply Chain Planning and Inventory
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT s.site_code, s.material_code, s.unrestricted_qty / NULLIF(s.avg_daily_use, 0) AS days_of_cover
FROM mm.plant_stock s
JOIN mm.material m ON m.material_code = s.material_code
WHERE m.category_code = 'CHEM' AND s.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM mm.plant_stock)
ORDER BY days_of_cover

graph_metrics.name: Positions at risk before the next receipt
graph_metrics.definition: Positions projected below safety stock, or short of a reservation, before their next confirmed receipt.
personas: Head of Supply Chain Planning and Inventory
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT s.site_code, s.material_code, s.unrestricted_qty, s.safety_stock_qty, r.required_qty, r.requirement_date, MIN(p.promised_date) AS next_receipt
FROM mm.plant_stock s
LEFT JOIN mm.reservation r ON r.site_code = s.site_code AND r.material_code = s.material_code AND r.status <> 'Closed'
LEFT JOIN pur.po_line p ON p.site_code = s.site_code AND p.material_code = s.material_code AND p.line_status LIKE 'Open%'
WHERE s.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM mm.plant_stock)
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
HAVING s.unrestricted_qty < COALESCE(r.required_qty, s.safety_stock_qty) AND (next_receipt IS NULL OR next_receipt > COALESCE(r.requirement_date, CURRENT_DATE()))

graph_metrics.name: Inventory value
graph_metrics.definition: Unrestricted stock at standard price, by business and site, at the latest snapshot.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT st.business_code, SUM(s.stock_value_usd) AS value_usd
FROM mm.plant_stock s
JOIN ops.site st ON st.site_code = s.site_code
WHERE s.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM mm.plant_stock)
GROUP BY st.business_code

graph_metrics.name: Slow-moving stock
graph_metrics.definition: Stock value of positions with no goods movement in the last 365 days.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT s.site_code, s.material_code, s.stock_value_usd, s.last_movement_date
FROM mm.plant_stock s
WHERE s.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM mm.plant_stock) AND s.last_movement_date < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 365 DAY)

graph_metrics.name: Inventory turns
graph_metrics.definition: Value issued over twelve months divided by average stock value, by business.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT st.business_code, SUM(CASE WHEN m.movement_type IN ('201', '261') THEN -m.amount_usd ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(AVG(s.stock_value_usd), 0) AS turns
FROM mm.stock_movement m
JOIN ops.site st ON st.site_code = m.site_code
JOIN mm.plant_stock s ON s.site_code = m.site_code AND s.material_code = m.material_code
WHERE m.posting_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 365 DAY)
GROUP BY st.business_code

graph_metrics.name: Stock that can move between sites
graph_metrics.definition: For each position below safety stock, the stock held at other sites above their own safety stock, and its business.
personas: Head of Supply Chain Planning and Inventory
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT need.site_code AS short_site, have.site_code AS holding_site, need.material_code, have.unrestricted_qty - have.safety_stock_qty AS releasable_qty
FROM mm.plant_stock need
JOIN mm.plant_stock have ON have.material_code = need.material_code AND have.site_code <> need.site_code AND have.snapshot_date = need.snapshot_date
WHERE need.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM mm.plant_stock)
  AND need.unrestricted_qty < need.safety_stock_qty AND have.unrestricted_qty > have.safety_stock_qty

graph_metrics.name: Outage material readiness
graph_metrics.definition: Reservation lines of a planned outage whose stock on hand, plus receipts promised before the requirement date, covers the required quantity.
personas: Head of Supply Chain Planning and Inventory
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT r.material_code, r.required_qty, r.requirement_date, s.unrestricted_qty, MIN(p.promised_date) AS next_receipt
FROM mm.reservation r
JOIN ops.work_order w ON w.work_order = r.work_order
JOIN mm.plant_stock s ON s.site_code = r.site_code AND s.material_code = r.material_code AND s.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM mm.plant_stock)
LEFT JOIN pur.po_line p ON p.site_code = r.site_code AND p.material_code = r.material_code AND p.line_status LIKE 'Open%'
WHERE w.outage_id = 'OUT-RAV-K2-2026'
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4

graph_metrics.name: Single-source critical items
graph_metrics.definition: Class A materials with one qualified supplier, with their stock across the group.
personas: Head of Supply Chain Planning and Inventory
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT m.material_code, m.description, m.preferred_vendor_id, SUM(s.unrestricted_qty) AS group_stock
FROM mm.material m
LEFT JOIN mm.plant_stock s ON s.material_code = m.material_code AND s.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM mm.plant_stock)
WHERE m.criticality = 'A' AND m.single_source
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3

graph_metrics.name: Spend on contracts expiring in six months
graph_metrics.definition: Spend in the last twelve months on contracts whose end date falls in the next six months.
personas: Category Manager, Maintenance, Repair and Operations
Category Manager, Chemicals and Process Materials
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT c.contract_no, c.title, c.end_date, SUM(p.ordered_usd) AS spend_usd
FROM src.contract c
JOIN pur.po_line p ON p.contract_no = c.contract_no AND p.ordered_on >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 12 MONTH)
WHERE c.end_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH)
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3

graph_metrics.name: Bid landed cost
graph_metrics.definition: Price plus average freight per unit for each bid, by lot, with qualification.
personas: Category Manager, Chemicals and Process Materials
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT b.lot_id, b.bidder_vendor_id, b.unit_price_usd, b.freight_usd_per_unit, b.unit_price_usd + b.freight_usd_per_unit AS landed_usd, b.qualified
FROM src.bid b
WHERE b.event_id = 'SE-2026-031'
ORDER BY b.lot_id, landed_usd

graph_metrics.name: Award saving on planned volumes
graph_metrics.definition: Planned volume times (current landed cost minus awarded landed cost), by lot, against the prior contract price as the savings policy defines it.
personas: Category Manager, Chemicals and Process Materials
graph_metrics.sql:
WITH vol AS (SELECT material_code, SUM(plan_tons) AS tons FROM ops.dosing_plan WHERE plan_year = 2027 GROUP BY material_code)
SELECT b.lot_id, v.tons, ci.unit_price_usd AS current_price, b.unit_price_usd + b.freight_usd_per_unit AS awarded_landed
FROM src.bid b
JOIN vol v ON v.material_code = b.material_code
JOIN src.contract_item ci ON ci.material_code = b.material_code AND ci.valid_to = '2026-12-31'
WHERE b.event_id = 'SE-2026-031' AND b.qualified

graph_metrics.name: Force majeure exposure
graph_metrics.definition: Volume a supplier in force majeure will not ship at its allocation, and what replacing it costs at spot prices.
personas: Category Manager, Chemicals and Process Materials
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT d.site_code, SUM(d.plan_tons) * 0.4 AS unshipped_tons_a_year
FROM ops.dosing_plan d
WHERE d.material_code = 'CHM-FECL-40' AND d.plan_year = 2027
GROUP BY d.site_code

graph_metrics.name: Spot premium over contract price
graph_metrics.definition: (Unit price minus contract price) times quantity on lines ordered under an exception code.
personas: Category Manager, Chemicals and Process Materials
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT p.exception_code, p.vendor_id, SUM(p.quantity) AS qty, SUM((p.unit_price_usd - p.contract_price_usd) * p.quantity) AS premium_usd
FROM pur.po_line p
WHERE p.exception_code IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2

graph_metrics.name: Open match exceptions
graph_metrics.definition: Three-way match exceptions still open, by type and age.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT e.exception_type, COUNT(*) AS open_exceptions, SUM(e.amount_usd) AS amount_usd
FROM ap.match_exception e
WHERE e.status = 'Open'
GROUP BY e.exception_type

graph_metrics.name: Orders raised after the invoice
graph_metrics.definition: Invoice lines whose order line was created after the invoice date.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS lines, SUM(invoiced_usd) AS amount_usd
FROM ap.invoice_line
WHERE after_the_fact_po AND invoice_date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'

graph_metrics.name: Suppliers per category
graph_metrics.definition: Suppliers with spend in each category and the share of the top supplier.
personas: Category Manager, Maintenance, Repair and Operations
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT category_code, COUNT(DISTINCT vendor_id) AS suppliers, MAX(v_spend) / SUM(v_spend) AS top_share
FROM (SELECT category_code, vendor_id, SUM(ordered_usd) AS v_spend FROM pur.po_line WHERE ordered_on >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1, 2)
GROUP BY category_code

graph_metrics.name: Spend-weighted payment terms
graph_metrics.definition: Payment terms in days, weighted by spend, against the 45-day policy.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT SUM(p.ordered_usd * v.payment_terms_days) / SUM(p.ordered_usd) AS weighted_terms_days
FROM pur.po_line p
JOIN pur.vendor v ON v.vendor_id = p.vendor_id
WHERE p.ordered_on >= '2026-01-01'

graph_metrics.name: Chemical use against plan
graph_metrics.definition: Run-rate use of each treatment chemical against the plan for the year, by site, with the date the plan was refreshed.
personas: Category Manager, Chemicals and Process Materials
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT d.site_code, d.material_code, d.run_rate_tons, d.plan_tons, d.refreshed_on
FROM ops.dosing_plan d
WHERE d.plan_year = 2027

graph_metrics.name: Demand plan accuracy
graph_metrics.definition: 1 minus the absolute difference between run-rate use and plan, divided by run-rate use, per chemical and site.
personas: Head of Supply Chain Planning and Inventory
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT d.material_code, 1 - ABS(d.run_rate_tons - d.plan_tons) / NULLIF(d.run_rate_tons, 0) AS accuracy
FROM ops.dosing_plan d
WHERE d.plan_year = 2026

graph_metrics.name: Open corrective actions
graph_metrics.definition: Suppliers with an open corrective action request in the latest quarter.
personas: Head of Supply Chain Planning and Inventory
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT vendor_id, quarter, otif_pct
FROM src.supplier_scorecard
WHERE car_open AND quarter = '2026-Q3'

graph_metrics.name: Expedite and premium freight cost
graph_metrics.definition: Expedite fees and premium freight booked on order lines, by supplier and reason.
personas: Head of Supply Chain Planning and Inventory
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT p.vendor_id, SUM(p.ordered_usd) AS expedite_usd
FROM pur.po_line p
WHERE p.material_code IS NULL AND p.category_code = 'LOGI' AND p.exception_code = 'EMG'
GROUP BY p.vendor_id

graph_metrics.name: Exception purchases
graph_metrics.definition: Ordered value placed under an exception code (force majeure FMX, emergency EMG), by code and month.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT exception_code, FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', ordered_on) AS month, SUM(ordered_usd) AS amount_usd
FROM pur.po_line
WHERE exception_code IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2

graph_metrics.name: Index-linked spend
graph_metrics.definition: Spend on contracts whose price follows an index, by index.
personas: Category Manager, Chemicals and Process Materials
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT c.index_clause, SUM(p.ordered_usd) AS spend_usd
FROM pur.po_line p
JOIN src.contract c ON c.contract_no = p.contract_no
WHERE c.index_clause IS NOT NULL AND p.ordered_on >= '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY c.index_clause

graph_metrics.name: Critical items without a reorder point
graph_metrics.definition: Class A positions with no reorder point set.
personas: Head of Supply Chain Planning and Inventory
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT s.site_code, s.material_code
FROM mm.plant_stock s
JOIN mm.material m ON m.material_code = s.material_code
WHERE m.criticality = 'A' AND s.reorder_point_qty IS NULL AND s.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM mm.plant_stock)

graph_metrics.name: Price paid for the same item across sites
graph_metrics.definition: For each material bought at more than one site, the range of unit prices paid in the period.
personas: Category Manager, Maintenance, Repair and Operations
Category Manager, Chemicals and Process Materials
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT p.material_code, MIN(p.unit_price_usd) AS low, MAX(p.unit_price_usd) AS high, COUNT(DISTINCT p.site_code) AS sites
FROM pur.po_line p
WHERE p.material_code IS NOT NULL AND p.ordered_on >= '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY p.material_code
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.site_code) > 1
